config.description: Bearer token, set by the installer. Run `npx -y -p @leadbay/mcp@latest installer` and sign in with your browser.

config.label: us or fr - Leadbay backend that owns your account
config.description: us or fr - Leadbay backend that owns your account.

config.label: Set to 0 to hide composite write tools (default: 1, ON)
config.description: Set to 0 to hide composite write tools (default: 1, ON).

config.label: Set to 1 to expose granular API tools
config.description: Set to 1 to expose granular API tools.

config.label: Product-usage telemetry (PostHog/Sentry)
config.description: Product-usage telemetry (PostHog/Sentry). Set to false to opt out. On a local/stdio install this env var is the ONLY way to stop telemetry — the account-level toggle (leadbay_set_telemetry) governs the hosted connector, not a local process (default: true).
